PFAS release risk, Massachusetts

Relative risk of a reported PFAS release per km², by 2020 census block group. Built only from public data.

Preliminary. Trained on 51 located PFAS releases (2021 seed list of MassDEP PFAS RTNs). Scores rank areas relative to each other; they are not probabilities of contamination.

Method, validation and data sources

How well it validates

Model: gradient_boosting. Scores shown are out-of-fold: each block group was scored by a model trained without its town.

The baseline uses block-group land area only. Larger areas see more reported releases, so the useful signal is how far the model gets beyond it.
